Mostly fixes for using Telescope with a keyboard or a screen reader.

## Fixed

- Tab and Shift+Tab reach every control now, also ones scrolled out of view, and the window scrolls to show them. Before, Tab only went through what was on screen, so each pass through the window stopped at different places.
- Dropdowns work with the keyboard. Space, Enter or Alt+Down opens one, the arrow keys pick and Esc closes it without changing anything. Space and Enter also work on every switch and button now.
- Every control has a name for screen readers. Some dropdowns, the Notes box and the Phone card's number boxes had none, and the Phone card's warnings now read "Battery under: Notify me" and "Hotter than: Notify me" instead of two identical "Notify me" switches. Icons are no longer read out.
- Sliders read their value with its unit (like "+0.0 EV") and the Up and Down keys change them. The colour wheels, the curve, the pan pad and the picture editor say where they're set too, for example "towards orange, 30%".
- Mirroring or flipping the picture no longer goes through the graphics card. A busy card, for example one that OBS is recording with, could slow every frame down even with all effects off.
